# Crevers

> AI content platform for creators, coaches and small business owners. Generates content ideas, scripts, carousels, captions and threads, repurposes one piece into several platform-native formats, produces AI voiceovers, resizes video for vertical, and learns your writing voice so output sounds like you.

## What Crevers Does

Crevers removes the blank page. You arrive with a niche or an idea, and it produces the ideas, scripts, captions, carousels and voiceovers for whatever platform you are posting to. It is a drafting tool, not an autoposter: you decide what to publish and it never posts on your behalf.

Built in Enugu, Nigeria, for creators everywhere.

## Features

- **Idea Generator** — 10 content ideas for your niche, written for a specific platform. Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, WhatsApp, or type your own. Copy, save, or send an idea straight to the calendar.
- **Script Writer** — short-form video scripts structured as hook, body and call to action.
- **Carousel Creator** — 7-slide Instagram carousels, labelled slide by slide.
- **Thread Writer** — Twitter/X threads of 6 tweets, each within the character limit.
- **Caption Writer** — Instagram captions with a hook, short value lines, a call to action and hashtags.
- **Repurposing Engine** — turn one piece into up to 4 formats in a single run: Twitter/X thread, LinkedIn post, Instagram caption, Reel script, YouTube description, email newsletter, Facebook post or WhatsApp status.
- **Brand Voice** — paste a few posts you have written and Crevers learns how you write, then matches it across everything it generates.
- **Voiceover Generator** — turn any script into audio in six AI voices, with adjustable speed.
- **Content Calendar** — plan the week, tick things off, and generate each piece from the plan.
- **AI Chat-bot** — content strategy help in the corner of every page, on every plan.
- **Video Resizer** — convert landscape video to vertical for Reels and TikTok, with AI face tracking.
- **Saved Projects** — everything you keep, searchable by title or content, filterable by format.

## Pricing

Prices are shown in US dollars and charged in Nigerian naira at checkout.

- **Free** — $0/month. 5 idea generations and 5 content pieces per day. Includes the AI Chat-bot, Content Calendar and Video Resizer. No credit card required.
- **Pro** — $1/month, or $10/year. All content formats, repurposing, AI face tracking, and 5 voiceovers a day at up to 2,000 characters.
- **Creator** — $4.50/month, or $45/year. Unlimited generations, unlimited voiceovers at up to 4,000 characters, priority support and early access.

Cancel any time from the dashboard.

## Common Questions

**Is it free to start?** Yes. The Free plan needs no card and works immediately.

**Does it post for me?** No. Crevers writes the draft; you publish it.

**Who owns what it writes?** You do, completely, including commercial use.

**Is my content used to train models?** No.

**How is it different from a general AI chatbot?** A chatbot gives you another blank box and you re-explain your niche, platform and tone every time. Crevers already knows those, writes natively for each platform, learns your voice, and keeps the calendar so ideas turn into posts.
